scoring_justification: Cannot recompute Delta_E or funnel ratios from raw minima data because only aggregated results are submitted; monotonic trends are the main claim and can be verified structurally without gold values.

outputs.description: Extracted energy differences and funnel population ratios for CLJ38 at μ_comp = 0, 0.25, 1, 5 ε, used to verify the monotonic trends: Delta_E must be strictly increasing and n_fcc_n_icos_ratio must be non-decreasing.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify that the returned arrays satisfy the structural relations: Delta_E[i+1] > Delta_E[i] and n_fcc_n_icos_ratio[i+1] >= n_fcc_n_icos_ratio[i] for i=0..2. The agent may use any robust PES sampling method; the computed values will differ from the paper’s exact numbers, but the monotonic trends should be preserved.

steps.description: Verify mu_comp matches [0,0.25,1,5], Delta_E is strictly increasing and all positive.
Verify mu_comp matches [0,0.25,1,5], n_fcc_n_icos_ratio is non-decreasing and all non-negative.
